name: Crown Tourist Home - Athirappilly Road, Kerala
description: Comfortable, budget-friendly tourist home on Chalakudy-Anamala Road in Pariyaram, Kerala, right beside the scenic Chalakudy River. 8 km from Chalakudy Railway Station, 28 km from Cochin Airport. Clean rooms & honest rates, attached washrooms, free Wi-Fi, and 24/7 CCTV near Athirappilly Waterfalls.
